messages:
deploybot: Tag created: v2.3.7-rc4 (commit 9f3a2b7). Environment: canary (us-west-2). Changelog (high level): - fix: batching fallback when seq lengths vary; - fix: KV-cache memory leak under heavy concurrent requests; - perf: improved attention kernel selection for small batches. Rollout plan: canary 2% for 30m -> 25% for 45m -> gradual ramp. Pin recommendation: do not pin global hosted customers to RC, pin Dedicated pools for perf testing. Full diff: <https://git.redwood.internal/r/redwood/runtime/compare/v2.3.6...v2.3.7-rc4>
celeste: LGTM. Staging smoke passed (conversation-tests and perf sanity). I ran `make smoke` against the rc4 image earlier.
ajay: I'll pin the dedicated-3-node pool for the next 6h for perf runs. Pin command: ``kubectl set image ds/redwood-runtime redwood-runtime=image:sha-9f3a2b7 --namespace=dedicated-prod``. Doing it in 2m and will post confirmation.
marisol: Quick ops notes: enable trace sampling at 100% for the first 15m post-promote. Set alert: latency_p95 > 240ms for 5m -> Pager if triggered. Also watch memory RSS on runtime nodes (KV leak fix watch).
taylor: Good. If we see regression, what's rollback steps?
ajay: Rollback plan (short): 1) Pause rollout via routing policy -> hold at current canary; 2) Promote previous tag v2.3.6 to desired pools; 3) Run `kubectl rollout undo deployment/redwood-runtime --namespace=prod --to-revision=$(revision-of-v2.3.6)`; 4) Re-pin dedicated pools back to v2.3.6. I'll keep v2.3.6 image in the registry for immediate switch.
celeste: One more ask: can we include the small prompt-regression test in the canary gate (5 queries from regression suite)? If they fail -> auto-hold.
ajay: Adding that to canary gate now: running lightweight eval harness (5 prompts) after each percentage bump. Will post results.
deploybot: Canary step complete: 2% -> no error spikes, eval gate passed (5/5), promoted to 25% at 2112233600.
marisol: Confirming trace sampling enabled and alert thresholds set. I'll watch the first 15m actively.
ajay: Dedicated pool pinned to rc4 and perf tests started (throughput + latency harness). Will share numbers in the #eng-releases thread when available.
taylor: Thx. If anything unexpected, tag me and @marisol.
deploybot: Status update at 2112233800: canary stable at 25%, no regressions observed. Next scheduled ramp in 30m unless blocked.
